proposals.reason: New MDCG guidance revises IVD classification grid for quality control materials under IVDR Annex VIII Rule 7, effective immediately.

card.t: MDCG 2020-16 rev.5 — IVD QC Classification Grid
card.x: Revised interpretation grid for quality control materials classification under IVDR Annex VIII Rule 7. No transition period; applies immediately to new submissions.

proposals.reason: [REVIEW: description entierement reecrite — verifier que ce n'est pas un nouveau jalon qui devrait etre un add] Status moved to in-force; expanded description to include 72h formal notification requirement and platform operational status.

card.t: CRA Art. 14 — Vulnerability Notification In Force
card.x: 24h early-warning + 72h formal notification to EU single reporting platform now mandatory for actively exploited vulnerabilities. Applies to products with digital elements already on market; companion apps and cloud components may be in scope.

proposals.reason: EN 18286:2026 (AI QMS for AI Act Art. 17) ratified and published, awaiting OJEU citation for presumption of conformity.

card.x: Harmonised standard for AI Act Article 17 QMS ratified 22 Jul 2026, available since 12 Jul. Awaiting OJEU citation to confer presumption of conformity.

proposals.reason: Final vote on prEN 18228 (AI risk management for AI Act Art. 9) scheduled; will determine progression to harmonised standard.

card.t: prEN 18228 — AI Risk Management Final Vote
card.x: Final vote on AI Act Article 9 risk management standard. If approved, will progress to EN 18228:2026 and eventual OJEU citation as harmonised standard.

proposals.reason: Final vote on prEN 18229-1 (AI trustworthiness logging) scheduled; part 3 human oversight in public inquiry until 22 Oct 2026.

card.x: Final vote on AI trustworthiness Part 1 (logging). Part 3 (human oversight) under public inquiry until 22 Oct 2026; Parts 2, 4-5 in drafting.

proposals.reason: CNIL issued €300,000 fine for violation of data subject rights; reinforces heightened enforcement of GDPR Articles 15-21 in health sector.

card.x: Administrative fine for GDPR data subject rights violations. Follows €500k fine to Hôpital Privé de la Loire (3 Sep 2026) for security breach.

proposals.reason: NHS-led commission published AI healthcare regulatory blueprint; signals UK divergence from EU AI Act approach.

card.x: NHS-led independent commission published AI regulatory blueprint. Non-binding but shapes future UK framework; diverges from EU AI Act.
